segment.source: Renders a dense two-column checklist where every row is a ticked or crossed line with an optional short qualifier at the end. Use it for: 'everything included' bands, scope-of-work summaries, package contents, requirement lists on tender and grant pages, delivery inclusions. Prefer 'Spec Sheet' when each row carries a measured value rather than a yes or no, and 'Us vs the Status Quo' when the ticks only mean something next to somebody else's crosses.
